components.what_it_is: 2440-line single-seam composer, `compose(adopter_dir, parent_trees) -> (evidence document dict, {path: rendered file})`. Tickets 12-16 of the policy-composition effort. Resolves every declared parent edge to a commit SHA (Flux pin for controls/implementations, git log on a version subdir for pricing/threat), loads every ValidatingPolicy/MutatingPolicy/GeneratingPolicy of every live policy version keyed on (identity family, version-stripped name), renders each back with a composed-for label + inherited-from/source-path annotations, writes an advisory composed/HEADER.yaml, and refuses on: split diamond, cross-party rule conflict, restatement of a non-ValidatingPolicy, unknown control id, dangling claim, claim against another party's policy, new hole, removed control, baseline widening, new ungoverned namespace, missing appetite band, unpriceable inability. Also prices every pricing/threat edge twice (old header pin vs this run's pin).
